name: mentos rainbow
ingredients_raw: Sugar, liquid glucose, hydrogenated vegetable oil, acidity regulators (INS 330, INS 525), starch, fruit powder [strawberry (0.07%), orange (0.10%), watermelon (0.06%) and pineapple (0.05%)], thickeners (INS 414, INS 418), flavours [nature-identical and artificial (watermelon)], emulsifier (INS 473), glazing agent (INS 903), colors (INS 110, INS 102, INS 127, INS 132).
